main.description: A 'now' page entry describing what the author is currently focused on. Append-only stream — the most recent record by createdAt is the current now page.

body.description: Now page content in markdown. Describes what the author is currently doing, making, reading, or focused on.

summary.description: Optional one-line summary for previews and feeds.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this now entry was written. The latest by this field is the current now page.
